title: Introduction to Machine Learning
prerequisites: To enrol in this course you must have completed COMP1110 or COMP1140 .
requisite_raw: To enrol in this course you must have completed COMP1110 or COMP1140 . Incompatible with COMP6670 .
description: Essential foundations for any machine learning application are a basic statistical analysis of the data to be processed, a solid understanding of the mathematical foundations underpinning machine learning as well as the basic classes of learning/adaptation concepts. Those foundations are bundled in this single, introductory course to machine learning in preparation for deeper explorations into the topic, but also as a standalone unit.
learning_outcomes: Develop an appreciation for what is involved in learning via data-driven approaches, like data collection, data safety and privacy, ethics in machine learning.
Describe a variety of machine learning tasks, like regression and classification, clustering, dimensionality reduction.
Understand how to formalise practical problems and evaluate model performance of machine learning tasks.
Interpret mathematical equations from linear algebra, calculus, statistics, probability theory and related mathematical topics in terms of machine learning methods.
Designing mathematical and statistical models using linear algebra, calculus, statistics, probability theory and related mathematical topics in terms of machine learning methods.
Understand advanced machine learning technologies including reinforcement learning, neural networks, and large models
